item.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Trump to Impose 10% Global Tariff, Launches Additional Trade Investigations
item.description: 🚨 TRUMP: “Today, I will sign an order to impose a 10% global tariff under Section 122, over and above our normal tariffs already being charged, and we’re also initiating several Section 301 and other investigations to protect our country from unfair trading practices of other countries and companies.”

item.title: BREAKING: Trump Rebukes Supreme Court, Imposes New Global Tariff
item.description: BREAKING: President Trump issues a blistering rebuke of the Supreme Court’s ruling striking down his tariffs, announces that he is imposing a new across-the-board global tariff under separate presidential powers.

item.title: Winter Storm Watch Issued for Tri-State Area, 6–12+ Inches Expected
item.description: UPDATE: A Winter Storm Watch has been issued for the Tri-State area from Sunday, 6am through Monday, 6am. Current forecasts call for potential snowfall totals of 6–12+ inches across much of the region, along with strong winds that could gust between 30–50 mph.
